sn55.3:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe || || 2.
sn55.3:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Dīghāvu upāsako ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno || || 3.
sn55.3:1.3: Atha kho Dīghāvu upāsako pitaraṃ Jotikaṃ gahapatim āmantesi ||
sn55.3:1.4: Ehi tvaṃ gahapati yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkama || upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena Bhagavato pāde sīrasā vanda ||
sn55.3:1.5: Dīghāvu bhante upāsako ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno ||
sn55.3:1.6: so Bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati || || Evaṃ
sn55.3:1.8: Sādhu kira bhante Bhagavā yena Dīghāvussa upāsakassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamatu anukampam upādāyāti || ||
sn55.3:1.9: Evaṃ tātā ti kho Jotiko gahapati Dīghāvussa upāsakassa paṭissutvā yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 4. Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Jotiko gahapati Bhagavantam etad avoca ||
sn55.3:1.10: Dīghāvu bhante upāsako ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno || ||
sn55.3:1.13: Sādhu kira bhante Bhagavā yena Dīghāvussa upāsakassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamatu anukampam upādāyāti || ||
sn55.3:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya yena Dīghāvussa upāsakassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi || nisajja kho Bhagavā Dīghāvum upāsakam etad avoca || ||
sn55.3:2.2: Kacci te Dīghāvu khamanīyam kacci yāpanīyaṃ kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti no abhikkamanti patikkamo sānam paññāyati no abhikkamoti || ||
sn55.3:2.3: Na me bhante khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ baḷhā me dukkhā abhikkamanti no patikkamanti abhikkamo sānam paññāyati no paṭikkamo ti || || 6.
sn55.3:2.4: Tasmā ti ha te Dīghāvu evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ ||
sn55.3:2.5: Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato bhavissāmi || Iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ || pe || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti || pe [pa] || ||
sn55.3:2.8: Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato bhavissāmi akhaṇḍehi || la-pe || samādhisaṃvattanikehi || ||
sn55.3:3.1: Yānimāni bhante Bhagavatā cattāri sotāpattiyaṅgāni desitāni || saṃvijjante te dhammā mayi ahañ ca tesu sandissāmi ||
sn55.3:3.2: ahañ hi bhante buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato || Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti ||
sn55.3:3.5: Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato akhaṇḍehi || la-pe || samādhisaṃvattanikehī ti || ||
sn55.3:3.6: Tasmā ti ha tvam Dīghāvu imesu catusu sotāpattiyaṅgesu patiṭṭhāya cha vijjābhāgiye dhamme uttariṃ bhāveyyāsi || || 8.
sn55.3:3.7: Idha tvam Dīghāvu sabbesaṅkhāresu aniccānupassī viharāhi || anicce dukkhasaññī dukkhe anattasaññī pahānasaññī virāgasaññī nirodhasaññī ti || || Evaṃ
sn55.3:4.1: Ye me bhante Bhagavatā cha vijjābhāgiyā dhammā desitā || saṃvijjante te dhammā mayi ahaṃ ca tesu dhammesu sandissāmi ||
sn55.3:4.2: ahañhi bhante sabbasaṅkhāresu aniccānupassī viharāmi || anicce dukkhasaññī dukkhe anattasaññī pahānasaññī virāgasaññī nirodhasaññī || || 9.
sn55.3:4.3: Api ca me bhante evaṃ hoti
sn55.3:4.4: māhevāyaṃ Jotiko gahapati mamaccayena vighātam āpajjīti || ||
sn55.3:4.5: Mā tvaṃ tāta Dīghāvu evam manasākāsi || ||
sn55.3:4.6: Iṅgha tvaṃ tāta Dīghāvu yad eva te Bhagavā āha tad eva tvaṃ sādhukam manasi karohī ti || || 10.
sn55.3:5.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Dīghāvum upāsakam iminā ovādena ovaditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi || || 11.
sn55.3:5.2: Atha kho Dīghāvu upāsako acirapakkantassa Bhagavato kālam akāsi || || 12.
sn55.3:5.3: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ ||
sn55.3:5.4: Yo so bhante Dīghāvu nāma upāsako Bhagavatā saṅkhittena ovādena ovādito so kālaṅkato ||
sn55.3:5.5: tassa kā gati ko abhisamparāyo ti || ||
sn55.3:5.6: Paṇḍito bhikkhave Dīghāvu upāsako ahosi paccapādi dhammassānudhammaṃ na ca dhammādhikaraṇaṃ vihesesi || || 13.
sn55.3:5.7: Dīghāvu bhikkhave upāsako pañcannam orambhāgiyānaṃ samyojanānam parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyi anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā
